image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: mobile professional hairstylist teaching case.
Primary request: one horizontal three-panel image of the SAME fictional adult East Asian man in his late 30s, showing front view, exact right-side profile and back view of ONE CURRENT UNSTYLED hairstyle. Same identity, same natural head proportions, same beige cotton crew-neck top, same lighting and framing in all views. Natural relaxed expression, lightly textured skin, no beauty reshaping. Distinct broad gentle jaw, no beard, no glasses.
Current hair: medium-length natural black-brown hair with soft irregular natural bends, not a perm-advertising curl. The fringe naturally falls loosely forwards and diagonally around the eyebrows, leaving a small uneven off-center forehead opening; no slicked-back roots, no sculpted quiff, no dramatic root lift. Hair over the upper ears and at the sides is a little full, with longer irregular ends around the nape; crown low-to-moderate volume. No fade, no skin exposure, no tight curls. This is a believable wash-and-dry everyday starting state, not a proposed redesign.
Composition: three equal panels, front/profile/back, at the same neutral eye-level camera scale. Include full top of head, complete fringe and nape hair perimeter, neck, BOTH shoulder contours and upper chest with generous margin in each panel. Shoulders relaxed, head not tilted. Plain neutral warm-gray background and consistent soft natural light. Realistic individual strands and ordinary mild shine, no salon glossy finish.
Purpose: learners compare current fringe direction, crown height, side fullness, back outline and head-neck-shoulder context before discussing styling effort.
Constraints: current condition only in all panels; no before/after, no styled-versus-unstyled comparison, no promised result; no text, labels, arrows, watermark, hands, tools, accessories, logos or inset reference pictures. Do not change facial proportions or hair length between views.
image.visualCheck: Original output and final WebP actually viewed: consistent fictional adult in front/right-profile/back, current forward-diagonal fringe, upper-side fullness and loose nape; head, complete hair perimeter and neck/shoulder context visible. Not a root-direction measurement or styled/home comparison.
